properties.text: Tsunami Information for Hawaii from the PTWC
Tsunami Information Bulletin from the PTWC

contents.bytes: At least 79 people killed, including 15 by a rockslide at Binabag; 1,271 injured; 10,566 homes destroyed and 185,888 damaged; 2,787 schools and 959 structures damaged, including 25 bridges, 11 roads and 3 seaports; widespread power outages and several landslides occurred in much of northern Cebu and parts of Central and Eastern Visayas. Coastal subsidence, fault scarps, multiple sinkholes and 200 m of surface rupture occurred in northern Cebu. Maximum intensity IX.
